Shenzhen Investment Limited 深圳控股有限公司
Annual Report 年報 2020



Corporate Profile
公司簡介




                                           Shenzhen Investment Limited has been listed on the Main
                                      Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited since 1997, is
                                the largest listed real estate company under State-owned Assets Supervision
                            and Administration Commission of Shenzhen Municipal. The Company’s core business
                            includes property development (including residential real estate, industrial real estate
                      and commercial complex), property investment and management. By intensifying its development
                   in Shenzhen, focusing on the Greater Bay Area and planning for its development in other core cities in
                    China, the Company is committed to be a first-class real estate developer and real estate operator.

               The Group currently has a land reserve with a planned total gross floor area close to 4.36 million square meters
             in various cities of China, of which the quality land reserve with a planned total gross floor area of approximately
          870,000 square meters is located in Shenzhen. The Company is committed to optimizing its land reserves structure, and
               concentrate its assets and business in the Greater Bay Area as well as key first-tier and second-tier cities.

                It has all along been the Company’s core strategic goal to promote the long term sustainable development of its
                     business, with an aim to bring a stable return and create value appreciation for its shareholders.

                深圳控股有限公司於1997年在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市，是深圳市國資委旗下最大的房地產上市公
                司。公司核心業務包括物業開發（包括住宅地產，產業地產及商業綜合體）、物業投資及管理。公司深耕
                  深圳，聚焦大灣區，佈局其他中國核心城市，致力於成為一流的房地產開發及不動產運營商。

                       目前本集團於國內多個城市合共擁有規劃總建築面積近436萬平方米的土地儲備，其中位於深
                        圳的優質土地儲備的規劃總建築面積約87萬平方米。公司致力優化土地儲備的結構，將
                                 資產和業務向大灣區和重點一二線城市集中。

                                       公司一貫之核心策略目標，乃致力推動業務長期持續發展，以期
                                           為股東帶來整體穩定回報及締造價值增長。




                                                                   公司深耕深圳，

                                                                           聚焦大灣區
                                                                        The Company intensifies its development in Shenzhen and
                                                                                                 focuses on the Greater Bay Area

In 2020, COVID-19 outbreak swept across the globe giving a heavy blow to the             2020 年，新冠疫情席捲全球，對全球經濟造成沉重
global economy and bringing profound impact on social development. In the                打擊，給社會發展帶來深遠的影響。中國在疫情初期
early stage of the epidemic, China took unconventional approaches to effectively         採取超常規的方式，有效遏制疫情，隨著強有力的常
contain the epidemic. With the establishment of an effective and regular epidemic        態化疫情防控體系的建立、適度的一攬子宏觀刺激政
prevention and control system, the implementation of a moderate package of               策的實施以及全面復工復產的推動，中國率先走出疫
macro stimulus policies and the promotion of comprehensive resumption of work            情困局，在全球主要經濟體中唯一實現經濟正增長。
and production, China took the lead in getting out of the epidemic dilemma and
was the only major economy in the world to see positive growth this year.

With the implementation of the macro policies, the real estate market gradually          在宏觀政策的作用下，房地產市場在二季度逐步擺脫
mitigated the impact of the COVID-19 in the second quarter, with stable and              疫情影響，整體發展穩定有序，「房住不炒」、「因城
orderly overall development. “House is a place to live instead of a tool for             施策」仍是房地產政策的主基調。下半年「三道紅線」
speculation” and “taking policies according to the local conditions” were still the      新規出台，融資監管持續收緊；深圳出台「新深八
main keynote in real estate sector. In the second half of the year, the “Three Red       條」樓市調控政策，商品房供應穩步增長，住宅市場
Lines” regulations were introduced, followed by increasingly tightened financing         全年成交量有較明顯上漲，價格穩定微升。而受經濟
supervision. Shenzhen Government introduced the “New Eight Rules” real estate            形勢影響，寫字樓市場出現了較高空置率，租金有所
market regulation policy, enabling the supply of commercial housing to grow              下調。
steadily, the housing market turnover to increase significantly throughout the
year, and the price to rise slightly. Affected by the economic situation, the office
market witnessed higher vacancy rate and reduced rent.

Impacts of COVID-19 Pandemic                                                            疫情影響
In 2020, the global economy was severely hit by the COVID-19. Amidst the                2020年全球經濟受到新冠疫情的巨大衝擊，面對疫情
complex market environment brought by the COVID-19, the Group proactively               帶來的複雜市場環境，本集團勇於承擔社會責任，積
shouldered its social responsibility by taking active actions to weather the            極防控，與業主及商戶共克時艱，在積極推動復工復
hardship together with homeowners and tenants. The Group has actively                   產的同時保持業績穩中求升。2021年中國疫情受到控
promoted the resumption of work and production while maintaining stable                 制，管理層相信疫情影響將逐步減少，本集團將會在
results with rising trend. In 2021, the epidemic will be under control in China,        常態防控下努力推進各項經營工作。
and the management believes that the impact of the epidemic will be gradually
reduced. The Group will endeavor to promote all business activities under normal
prevention and control.

In terms of sales, due to the impact of epidemic prevention and control, the            在銷售方面，受疫情防控影響，本集團旗下售樓中心

significantly affected the contracted sales in January and February 2020. In view       受到較為顯著的影響。針對疫情情況，本集團配合疫
of the epidemic situation, the Group, in line with the epidemic prevention and          情防控需求，啟動了在線全方位售樓平台，以便客戶
control needs, launched an online sales platform, which enables the customers to        在線查詢、認購及簽約，以在保障公共安全的同時，
inquire, subscribe and sign contracts online. Thus, the sale of projects can still be   項目銷售仍可妥善進行。全年來看，受疫情影響，可
properly carried out while guaranteeing public security. For the whole year, due        售貨值比原計劃有所減少，合同銷售也收到一定程度
to the epidemic, the saleable value has been reduced compared to the original           的影響。根據調整後的經營計劃，全年計劃推售貨值
plan, and the contracted sales have also been affected to a certain extent. The         調整為約280 億元人民幣，全年實現合同銷售約145

Highlight of ESG Report                                                               環境、社會、管治報告概要
In 2020, the Company was still making persistent efforts to achieve sustainability    2020年，本公司依舊在實現本集團的可持續發展目標
goal of the Group. Specifically, we have facilitated steady business operation        上不斷努力，我們融入國家和區域發展戰略，把握深

Risk Management and Internal Control                                                風險管理與內部監控
Responsibility                                                                      責任
The Board is responsible for the risk management and internal control systems       董事會須對風險管理及內部監控系統負責，有責任檢
and reviewing the effectiveness of such systems. Management is responsible for      討該等制度的有效性，而管理層則負責設計及執行內
designing and implementing an internal control system to manage the risks to the    部監控制度以最大限度的管理公司面臨的風險，達
Company to the maximum extent, in order to identify and manage these risks so       到識別和管理這些風險，從而可以掌握、降低、舒
as to understand, reduce, mitigate, divert or avoid these risks. The Board hereby   緩、轉移或規避這些風險。董事會謹在此闡釋該等系
explains that the systems are designed to manage, rather than eliminate, the risk   統旨在管理而非消除未能達成業務目標的風險，而且
of failure to meet business objectives, and only to provide reasonable, but not     只能就不會有重大的失實陳述或損失作出合理而非絕
absolute, assurance against material misstatement or loss.                          對的保證。

Risk Management Process                                                                 風險管理程序
The Company adopts an integrated “bottom-up” and “top-down” risk review                 公司採用「由下而上」的方式配合「由上而下」的綜合
process, requiring the heads of functional departments and business units of the        風險檢討程序，要求公司職能部門及業務部門主管參
Company to participate in identifying operational risks and incorporate them into       與識別營運風險，納入各項業務及決策流程中，包括

             ECLs are a probability-weighted estimate of credit losses. Credit                       預期信用損失是信用損失概率加權估

             Group in accordance with the contract and the cash flows that                           流量和本集團預期收到的現金流量之

                     effective interest rate determined at initial recognition or                                及其他應收款項：初始確認時
                     an approximation thereof;                                                                   確定的實際利率或其近似值；

                     the lease receivable; and                                                                   用之應收租金折現率；及

               –     variable-rate financial assets: current effective interest                           －      浮動利率金融資產：當前實際
                     rate.                                                                                       利率。

               The maximum period considered when estimating ECLs is the                                  估計預期信用損失時考慮的最長期限
               maximum contractual period over which the Group is exposed to                              是本集團面臨信用風險的最長合約
               credit risk.                                                                               期。

               or effort. This includes information about past events, current                            合理且可支持之信息，包括過去事
               conditions and forecasts of future economic conditions.                                    件、當前狀況和未來經濟狀況預測

            shareholdings and under equal terms. Accordingly, the shareholder’s loan forms an                     提供貸款。因此，股東貸款構成本集團於合

39 Financial risk management                                                           39 財務風險管理
    Exposure to credit, liquidity, interest rate and currency risks arises in the            本集團面臨正常業務過程中發生之信貸、流動
    normal course of the Group’s business. The Group is also exposed to                      性、利率及貨幣風險。本集團亦面臨因其對其
    equity price risk arising from its equity investments in other entities and              他實體股權投資產生之股權價格風險及自身權益
    movements in its own equity share price.                                                 股價格變動風險。

    The Group’s exposure to these risks and the financial risk management                    本集團面臨之該等風險及金融風險管理政策以及
    policies and practices used by the Group to manage these risks are                       本集團管控該等風險所採用之慣例詳述如下。
    described below.

    (a) Credit risk                                                                          (a) 信貸風險
        The Group’s credit risk arising from cash and cash equivalents,                          本集團的信貸風險產生自現金及現金等價
        restricted cash, trade receivables, other receivables, loans to related                  物、受限制現金、應收賬款、其他應收
        parties and financial guarantee on mortgage loans. Among these                           款項、給予關聯方貸款及抵押貸款金融擔
        credit risk exposure, the Group’s exposure to credit risk arising from                   保。在該等信貸風險中，本集團產生自現
        cash and cash equivalents and restricted cash is limited because the                     金及現金等價物及受限制現金的信貸風險
        counterparties are state-owned financial institutions and reputable                      有限，因為交易對手為屬於高信貸質量金
        banks which are all high-credit-quality financial institutions.                          融機構的國有金融機構及著名銀行。

         The Group has no significant concentrations of credit risk, with                           本集團並無重大集中信貸風險，所面對之
         exposure spread over a large number of counterparties and                                  風險分散於多名交易對手及客戶。於報
         customers. At the end of the reporting period, 5% (2019: 6%) and                           告期末，應收賬款總額的5%（2019年：
         17% (2019: 19%) of the total trade receivables was due from the                            6%）及17%（2019年：19%）分別來自本
         Group’s largest customer and the five largest customers respectively.                      集團最大客戶及五大客戶。

         For trade receivables in respect of property development, the Group                        就有關物業發展的應收賬款而言，本集團
         has policies in place to ensure that sales are made to purchasers                          已實行政策確保向具有適當財務實力及支
         with an appropriate financial strength and appropriate percentage of                       付適當百分比首期付款之買家作出銷售。
         down payments. It also has other monitoring procedures to ensure                           本集團亦制定有其他監控程序，以確保採
         that follow-up action is taken to recover overdue debts. In addition,                      取跟進措施收回逾期債務。此外，本集團
         the Group reviews regularly the recoverable amount of each individual                      定期審閱每名個人之應收貿易賬款可收回
         trade receivables to ensure that adequate loss allowance are made                          金額，以確保就不可收回金額作出足夠損
